title: powernode-provision document v1
description: One document for every provisioning channel (USB file, cloud-init/NoCloud/config-drive, provider metadata, PXE pickup). Emitted by System::ProvisioningDocument, parsed strictly by agent/internal/identity.ParseProvisionDocument. Duplicate keys, case-variant keys (e.g. "CA_FINGERPRINT"), nulls and nested values are INVALID even though a generic JSON Schema validator cannot express that; the agent rejects them.

server.description: Platform base URL. https only, no credentials, no spaces; port, if present, 1..65535 (not expressible here).

key.description: Single-use bootstrap token (plaintext, present only in this document).

ca_fingerprint.description: ALWAYS REQUIRED. sha256 of the DER of the LAST certificate of the configured CA chain, which must be a self-signed CA. Enforced on the enrolment connection.

ca_pem.description: Optional CA chain (PEM, printable ASCII). Ordered ANCHOR-LAST. If present, one certificate in it MUST match ca_fingerprint.
